title: The jar that never fills
label: THE JAR THAT NEVER FILLS
lead: Hook 2, because everyone has watched savings stay flat without buying anything big, and the question opens a gap the last beats close.

hooks.label: YOUR JAR VS YOUR COFFEE
hooks.say: Your savings jar gets a coin on payday. Your coffee gets one every morning.

hooks.label: THE JAR THAT NEVER FILLS
hooks.say: Why does your savings jar stay *empty* when you never buy anything big?

hooks.label: WHERE DID IT ALL GO?
hooks.say: You open your banking app, see the balance, and wonder where it all went.

beats.say: Why does your savings jar stay *empty* when you never buy anything big?
beats.scene: A glass savings jar on a dark table. A single coin drops through the lid slot and rattles at the bottom, alone.

beats.say: Because the money slips out in bits too *small* to notice.
beats.scene: Low side angle on the jar. Coins lift out of it one by one and drift away into the dark.

beats.say: A coffee on the way, a snack after lunch, a little delivery fee.
beats.scene: High angle on a pale counter. A coffee cup, a snack box and a phone showing a delivery fee land one after another on each word.

beats.say: None of them feel worth counting, so the month ends and the jar *hasn't* moved.
beats.scene: Night room. Receipts flutter down and pile up beside the jar while a wall calendar flips its pages. The jar stays as empty as before.

beats.say: Watch the small spends for just one week, and you'll see where it *goes*.
beats.scene: A pendant lamp switches on over the jar. The receipts light up and coins start dropping back into the jar.

beats.say: Send this to the friend who's always broke, with an iced coffee in hand.
beats.scene: Warm room. An iced coffee cup beside a fuller jar, a phone screen lights up with a send arrow.
